ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows yellow cubes stuck together into one connected solid figure. The cubes are all part of the same piece; there is no separate disconnected group. The arrangement includes horizontal cubes forming a connected base and vertical stacks rising from it. Reasoning: The problem states that Hansi uses 12 cubes total, and each drop of glue joins one cube to another cube. Starting with 12 separate cubes, each glue drop can reduce the number of separate pieces by 1. To make all 12 cubes into one connected figure, the number of joins needed is 12 - 1 = 11. Therefore, he needs 11 drops of glue.
